verses.en: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
verses.fr: Celui qui aime la correction aime la science; Celui qui hait la réprimande est stupide.
verses.am: ተግሣጽን የሚወድድ እውቀትን ይወድዳል፤ ዘለፋን የሚጠላ ግን ደንቆሮ ነው።

verses.en: A good man obtaineth favour of the Lord: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
verses.fr: L''homme de bien obtient la faveur de l''Eternel, Mais l''Eternel condamne celui qui est plein de malice.
verses.am: ደኅና ሰው ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሞገስን ያገኛል፤ ተንኰለኛውን ሰው ግን ይቀሥፈዋል።

verses.en: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.fr: L''homme ne s''affermit pas par la méchanceté, Mais la racine des justes ne sera point ébranlée.
verses.am: ሰውን ዓመፃ አያጸናውም፤ የጻድቃን ሥር ግን አይንቀሳቀስም።

verses.en: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.fr: Une femme vertueuse est la couronne de son mari, Mais celle qui fait honte est comme la carie dans ses os.
verses.am: ልባም ሴት ለባልዋ ዘውድ ናት፤ አሳፋሪ ሴት ግን በአጥንቱ ውስጥ እንደ ቅንቅን ናት።

verses.en: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
verses.fr: Les pensées des justes ne sont qu''équité; Les desseins des méchants ne sont que fraude.
verses.am: የጻድቃን አሳብ ቅን ነው፤ የኃጥኣን ምክር ግን ተንኰል ነው።

verses.en: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
verses.fr: Les paroles des méchants sont des embûches pour verser le sang, Mais la bouche des hommes droits est une délivrance.
verses.am: የኃጥኣን ቃል ደምን ለማፍሰስ ትሸምቃለች፤ የቅኖች አፍ ግን ይታደጋቸዋል።

verses.en: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.fr: Renversés, les méchants ne sont plus; Et la maison des justes reste debout.
verses.am: ኀጥኣን ይገለበጣሉ፥ ደግሞም አይገኙም፤ የጻድቃን ቤት ግን ጸንቶ ይኖራል።

verses.en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
verses.fr: Un homme est estimé en raison de son intelligence, Et celui qui a le coeur pervers est l''objet du mépris.
verses.am: ሰው በጥበቡ ይመሰገናል፤ ልቡ ጠማማ የሆነ ሰው ግን ይናቃል።

verses.en: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut être d''une condition humble et avoir un serviteur Que de faire le glorieux et de manquer de pain.
verses.am: ለራሱ ባሪያ ሆኖ የተጠቃ ሰው እንጀራ ጐድሎት ራሱን ካከበረው ሰው ይሻላል።

verses.en: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.fr: Le juste prend soin de son bétail, Mais les entrailles des méchants sont cruelles.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ሰው ለእንስሳው ነፍስ ይራራል፤ የኀጥኣን ምሕረት ግን ጨካኝ ነው።

verses.en: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
verses.fr: Celui qui cultive son champ est rassasié de pain, Mais celui qui poursuit des choses vaines est dépourvu de sens.
verses.am: ምድሩን የሚሠራ ሰው እንጀራ ይጠግባል፤ ለከንቱ ነገር የሚሮጥ ግን አእምሮ የጐደለው ነው።

verses.en: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
verses.fr: Le méchant convoite ce que prennent les méchants, Mais la racine des justes donne du fruit.
verses.am: የኅጥኣን ፈቃድ የክፉዎች ወጥመድ ናት፤ የጻድቃን ሥር ግን ፍሬን ያፈራል።

verses.en: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
verses.fr: Il y a dans le péché des lèvres un piège pernicieux, Mais le juste se tire de la détresse.
verses.am: ክፉ ሰው በከንፈሩ ኃጢአት ይጠመዳል፤ ጻድቅ ግን ከመከራ ያመልጣል።

verses.en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.fr: Par le fruit de la bouche on est rassasié de biens, Et chacun reçoit selon l''oeuvre de ses mains.
verses.am: የሰው ነፍስ ከአፉ ፍሬ መልካም ነገርን ትጠግባለች፥ ሰውም እንደ እጁ ሥራ ዋጋውን ይቀበላል።

verses.en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
verses.fr: La voie de l''insensé est droite à ses yeux, Mais celui qui écoute les conseils est sage.
verses.am: የሰነፍ መንገድ በዓይኑ የቀናች ናት፤ ጠቢብ ግን ምክርን ይሰማል።

verses.en: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
verses.fr: L''insensé laisse voir à l''instant sa colère, Mais celui qui cache un outrage est un homme prudent.
verses.am: የሰነፍ ቍጣ ቶሎ ይታወቃል፤ ብልህ ሰው ግን ነውርን ይሰውራል።

verses.en: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
verses.fr: Celui qui dit la vérité proclame la justice, Et le faux témoin la tromperie.
verses.am: እውነተኛን ነገር የሚናገር ቅን ነገርን ያወራል፤ የሐሰት ምስክር ግን ተንኰልን ያወራል።

verses.en: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
verses.fr: Tel, qui parle légèrement, blesse comme un glaive; Mais la langue des sages apporte la guérison.
verses.am: እንደሚዋጋ ሰይፍ የሚለፈልፍ ሰው አለ፤ የጠቢባን ምላስ ግን ጤና ነው።

verses.en: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
verses.fr: La lèvre véridique est affermie pour toujours, Mais la langue fausse ne subsiste qu''un instant.
verses.am: የእውነት ከንፈር ለዘላለም ትቆማለች፤ ውሸተኛ ምላስ ግን ለቅጽበት ነው።

verses.en: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
verses.fr: La tromperie est dans le coeur de ceux qui méditent le mal, Mais la joie est pour ceux qui conseillent la paix.
verses.am: ክፉን በሚያስቡ ልብ ውስጥ ተንኰል አለ፤ በሰላም ለሚመክሩ ግን ደስታ አላቸው።

verses.en: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
verses.fr: Aucun malheur n''arrive au juste, Mais les méchants sont accablés de maux.
verses.am: ጻድቅን መከራ አያገኘውም፤ ኀጥኣን ግን ክፋትን የተሞሉ ናቸው።

verses.en: Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: but they that deal truly are his delight.
verses.fr: Les lèvres fausses sont en horreur à l''Eternel, Mais ceux qui agissent avec vérité lui sont agréables.
verses.am: ውሸተኛ ከንፈር በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አሰጸያፊ ነው፤ እውነትን የሚያደርጉ ግን በእርሱ ዘንድ የተወደዱ ናቸው።

verses.en: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.fr: L''homme prudent cache sa science, Mais le coeur des insensés proclame la folie.
verses.am: ብልህ ሰው እውቀትን ይሸሽጋል፤ የሰነፎች ልብ ግን ስንፍናን ያወራል።

verses.en: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
verses.fr: La main des diligents dominera, Mais la main lâche sera tributaire.
verses.am: የትጉ እጅ ትገዛለች፤ የታካች እጅ ግን ትገብራለች።

verses.en: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
verses.fr: L''inquiétude dans le coeur de l''homme l''abat, Mais une bonne parole le réjouit.
verses.am: ሰውን የልቡ ኀዘን ያዋርደዋል፤ መልካም ቃል ግን ደስ ያሰኘዋል።

verses.en: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
verses.fr: Le juste montre à son ami la bonne voie, Mais la voie des méchants les égare.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ለባልንጀራው መንገዱን ያሳያል፤ የኀጥኣን መንገድ ግን ታስታቸዋለች።

verses.en: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
verses.fr: Le paresseux ne rôtit pas son gibier; Mais le précieux trésor d''un homme, c''est l''activité.
verses.am: ታካች ሰው አደን ምንም አያድንም፤ ለሰው የከበረ ሀብት ትጋት ነው።

verses.en: In the way of righteousness is life: and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
verses.fr: La vie est dans le sentier de la justice, La mort n''est pas dans le chemin qu''elle trace.
verses.am: በጽድቅ መንገድ ላይ ሕይወት አለ በጎዳናዋም ሞት የለም።

verses.en: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
verses.fr: Un fils sage écoute l''instruction de son père, Mais le moqueur n''écoute pas la réprimande.
verses.am: ባለ አእምሮ ልጅ የአባቱን ተግሣጽ ይሰማል። ፌዘኛ ግን ተግሣጽን አይሰማም።

verses.en: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
verses.fr: Par le fruit de la bouche on jouit du bien; Mais ce que désirent les perfides, c''est la violence.
verses.am: ሰው ከአፉ ፍሬ መልካምን ይበላል፤ የዓመፀኞች ነፍስ ግን ግፍን ትሻለች።

verses.en: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
verses.fr: Celui qui veille sur sa bouche garde son âme; Celui qui ouvre de grandes lèvres court à sa perte.
verses.am: አፉን የሚጠብቅ ነፍሱን ይጠብቃል፤ ከንፈሩን የሚያሞጠሙጥ ግን ጥፋትን ያገኘዋል።

verses.en: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
verses.fr: L''âme du paresseux a des désirs qu''il ne peut satisfaire; Mais l''âme des hommes diligents sera rassasiée.
verses.am: የታካች ሰው ነፍስ ትመኛለች፤ አንዳችም አታገኝም፤ የትጉ ነፍስ ግን ትጠግባለች።

verses.en: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
verses.fr: Le juste hait les paroles mensongères; Le méchant se rend odieux et se couvre de honte.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ሐሰትን ይጠላል፤ ኀጥእ ግን ያሳፍራል ያስነውራልም።

verses.en: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
verses.fr: La justice garde celui dont la voie est intègre, Mais la méchanceté cause la ruine du pécheur.
verses.am: በመንገዱ ያለ ነውር የሚሄደውን ጽድቅ ይጠብቀዋል፤ ኃጢአት ግን ኃጢአተኛውን ይጥለዋል።

verses.en: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
verses.fr: Tel fait le riche et n''a rien du tout, Tel fait le pauvre et a de grands biens.
verses.am: ራሱን ባለጠጋ የሚያስመስል ሰው አለ፥ ነገር ግን አንዳች የለውም፤ ራሱን ድሀ የሚያስመስል አለ፥ ነገር ግን እጅግ ባለጠግነት አለው።

verses.en: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
verses.fr: La richesse d''un homme sert de rançon pour sa vie, Mais le pauvre n''écoute pas la réprimande.
verses.am: ለሰው ነፍስ ቤዛው ሀብቱ ነው፤ ድሀ ግን ተግሣጽን አይሰማም።

verses.en: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.fr: La lumière des justes est joyeuse, Mais la lampe des méchants s''éteint.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ ለጻድቃን ብርሃን ነው፤ የኀጥኣን መብራት ግን ይጠፋል።

verses.en: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
verses.fr: C''est seulement par orgueil qu''on excite des querelles, Mais la sagesse est avec ceux qui écoutent les conseils.
verses.am: በትዕቢት ጠብ ብቻ ይሆናል፤ ጥበብ ግን ምክርን በሚቀበሉ ዘንድ ናት።

verses.en: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
verses.fr: La richesse mal acquise diminue, Mais celui qui amasse peu à peu l''augmente.
verses.am: በችኰላ የምትከማች ሀብት ትጐድላለች፤ ጥቂት በጥቂት የተከማቸች ግን ትበዛለች።

verses.en: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
verses.fr: Un espoir différé rend le coeur malade, Mais un désir accompli est un arbre de vie.
verses.am: የምትዘገይ ተስፋ ልብን ታሳዝናለች፤ የተገኘች ፈቃድ ግን የሕይወት ዛፍ ናት።

verses.en: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
verses.fr: Celui qui méprise la parole se perd, Mais celui qui craint le précepte est récompensé.
verses.am: ትእዛዝን የሚያቃልል በትእዛዝ ተይዞ ይጠፋል፤ ትእዛዝን የሚፈራ ግን በደኅንነት ይኖራል።

verses.en: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.fr: L''enseignement du sage est une source de vie, Pour détourner des pièges de la mort.
verses.am: ሰው ከሞት ወጥመድ ያመልጥ ዘንድ የጠቢብ ሰው ትምህርት የሕይወት ምንጭ ነው።

verses.en: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
verses.fr: Une raison saine a pour fruit la grâce, Mais la voie des perfides est rude.
verses.am: መልካም እውቀት ሞገስን ይሰጣል፤ የወስላቶች መንገድ ግን ሸካራ ናት።

verses.en: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
verses.fr: Tout homme prudent agit avec connaissance, Mais l''insensé fait étalage de folie.
verses.am: ብልህ ሁሉ በእውቀት ይሠራል፤ ሰነፍ ግን ስንፍናውን ይገልጣል።

verses.en: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
verses.fr: Un envoyé méchant tombe dans le malheur, Mais un messager fidèle apporte la guérison.
verses.am: መጥፎ መልእክተኛ በክፉ ላይ ይወድቃል፤ የታመነ መልእክተኛ ግን ፈውስ ነው።

verses.en: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
verses.fr: La pauvreté et la honte sont le partage de celui qui rejette la correction, Mais celui qui a égard à la réprimande est honoré.
verses.am: ድህነትና ነውር ተግሣጽን ቸል ለሚሉ ነው፤ ዘለፋን የሚሰማ ግን ይከብራል።

verses.en: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.fr: Un désir accompli est doux à l''âme, Mais s''éloigner du mal fait horreur aux insensés.
verses.am: የተፈጸመች ፈቃድ ሰውነትን ደስ ታሰኛለች፤ ሰነፎች ግን ከክፉ መራቅን ይጸየፋሉ።

verses.en: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
verses.fr: Celui qui fréquente les sages devient sage, Mais celui qui se plaît avec les insensés s''en trouve mal.
verses.am: ከጠቢባን ጋር የሚሄዱ ጠቢብ ይሆናል፤ የሰነፎች ባልንጀራ ግን ክፉ መከራን ይቀበላል።

verses.en: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
verses.fr: Le malheur poursuit ceux qui pèchent, Mais le bonheur récompense les justes.
verses.am: ክፉ ነገር ኃጢአተኞችን ያሳድዳቸዋል፤ ጻድቃን ግን መልካሙን ዋጋ ይቀበላሉ።

verses.en: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
verses.fr: L''homme de bien a pour héritiers les enfants de ses enfants, Mais les richesses du pécheur sont réservées pour le juste.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ሰው ለልጅ ልጆቹ ያወርሳል፤ የኃጢአተኛ ብልጥግና ግን ለጻድቅ ትጠበቃለች።

verses.en: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
verses.fr: Le champ que défriche le pauvre donne une nourriture abondante, Mais tel périt par défaut de justice.
verses.am: በድሆች እርሻ ላይ ብዙ ሲሳይ አለ፤ ከፍርድ መጕደል የተነሣ ግን ይጠፋል።

verses.en: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verses.fr: Celui qui ménage sa verge hait son fils, Mais celui qui l''aime cherche à le corriger.
verses.am: በበትር ከመምታት የሚራራ ሰው ልጁን ይጠላል፤ ልጁን የሚወድድ ግን ተግቶ ይገሥጻዋል።

verses.en: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
verses.fr: Le juste mange et satisfait son appétit, Mais le ventre des méchants éprouve la disette.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ሰውነቱ እስክትጠግብ ድረስ ይበላል፤ የኀጥኣን ሆድ ግን ይራባል።

verses.en: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
verses.fr: La femme sage bâtit sa maison, Et la femme insensée la renverse de ses propres mains.
verses.am: ብልሃተኛ ሴት ቤትዋን ትሠራለች፤ ሰነፍ ሴት ግን በእጅዋ ታፈርሰዋለች።

verses.en: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the Lord: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
verses.fr: Celui qui marche dans la droiture craint l''Eternel, Mais celui qui prend des voies tortueuses le méprise.
verses.am: በቅን የሚሄድ ሰው እግዚአብሔርን ይፈራል፤ መንገዱን የሚያጣምም ግን ይንቀዋል።

verses.en: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
verses.fr: Dans la bouche de l''insensé est une verge pour son orgueil, Mais les lèvres des sages les gardent.
verses.am: በሰነፍ አፍ የትዕቢት በትር አለ፤ የጠቢባን ከንፈር ግን ትጠብቃቸዋለች።

verses.en: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.fr: S''il n''y a pas de boeufs, la crèche est vide; C''est à la vigueur des boeufs qu''on doit l''abondance des revenus.
verses.am: በሬ በሌለበት ስፍራ እህል አይገኝም፤ ብዙ ሲሳይ ግን በበሬዎች ኃይል ነው።

verses.en: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
verses.fr: Un témoin fidèle ne ment pas, Mais un faux témoin dit des mensonges.
verses.am: የታመነ ምስክር አይዋሽም፤ የሐሰት ምስክር ግን በሐሰት ይናገራል።

verses.en: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
verses.fr: Le moqueur cherche la sagesse et ne la trouve pas, Mais pour l''homme intelligent la science est chose facile.
verses.am: ፌዘኛ ሰው ጥበብን ይፈልጋል አያገኛትም፤ ለአስተዋይ ግን እውቀትን ማግኘት አያስቸግረውም።

verses.en: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
verses.fr: Eloigne-toi de l''insensé; Ce n''est pas sur ses lèvres que tu aperçois la science.
verses.am: ከሰነፍ ሰው ፊት ራቅ፥ በእርሱ ዘንድ የእውቀትን ከንፈር አታገኝምና።

verses.en: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.fr: La sagesse de l''homme prudent, c''est l''intelligence de sa voie; La folie des insensés, c''est la tromperie.
verses.am: የብልህ ሰው ጥበብ መንገዱን ያስተውል ዘንድ ነው፤ የሰነፎች ስንፍና ግን ሽንገላ ነው።

verses.en: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
verses.fr: Les insensés se font un jeu du péché, Mais parmi les hommes droits se trouve la bienveillance.
verses.am: ሰነፉ በኃጢአት ያፌዛል፤ በቅኖች መካከል ግን ቸርነት አለች።

verses.en: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
verses.fr: Le coeur connaît ses propres chagrins, Et un étranger ne saurait partager sa joie.
verses.am: የራሱን ኀዘን ልብ ያውቃል፤ ከደስታውም ጋር ሌላ ሰው አይገናኝም።

verses.en: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
verses.fr: La maison des méchants sera détruite, Mais la tente des hommes droits fleurira.
verses.am: የኅጥኣን ቤት ይፈርሳል፤ የቅኖች ማደሪያ ግን ያብባል።

verses.en: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.fr: Telle voie paraît droite à un homme, Mais son issue, c''est la voie de la mort.
verses.am: ለሰው ቅን የምትመስል መንገድ አለች ፍጻሜዋ ግን የሞት መንገድ ነው።

verses.en: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
verses.fr: Au milieu même du rire le coeur peut être affligé, Et la joie peut finir par la détresse.
verses.am: በሳቅ ደግሞ ልብ ያዝናል፥ የደስታም ፍጻሜ ልቅሶ ነው።

verses.en: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
verses.fr: Celui dont le coeur s''égare se rassasie de ses voies, Et l''homme de bien se rassasie de ce qui est en lui.
verses.am: ልቡን ከጽድቅ የሚመልስ ሰው ከመንገዱ ፍሬ ይጠግባል፥ ጻድቅም ሰው ደግሞ በራሱ።

verses.en: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
verses.fr: L''homme simple croit tout ce qu''on dit, Mais l''homme prudent est attentif à ses pas.
verses.am: የዋህ ቃልን ሁሉ ያምናል፤ ብልህ ግን አካሄዱን ይመለከታል።

verses.en: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
verses.fr: Le sage a de la retenue et se détourne du mal, Mais l''insensé est arrogant et plein de sécurité.
verses.am: ጠቢብ ሰው ይፈራል ከክፉም ይሸሻል፤ ሰነፍ ግን ራሱን ታምኖ ይኰራል።

verses.en: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
verses.fr: Celui qui est prompt à la colère fait des sottises, Et l''homme plein de malice s''attire la haine.
verses.am: ቍጡ ሰው በስንፍና ይሠራል፤ አስተዋይ ግን ይታገሣል።

verses.en: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.fr: Les simples ont en partage la folie, Et les hommes prudents se font de la science une couronne.
verses.am: አላዋቂዎች ሰዎች ስንፍናን ይወርሳሉ፤ ብልሆች ግን እውቀትን እንደ ዘውድ ይጭናሉ።

verses.en: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.fr: Les mauvais s''inclinent devant les bons, Et les méchants aux portes du juste.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች በደጎች ፊት ይጐነበሳሉ፥ ኀጥኣንም በጻድቃን በር።

verses.en: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
verses.fr: Le pauvre est odieux même à son ami, Mais les amis du riche sont nombreux.
verses.am: ድሀ በባልንጀራው ዘንድ የተጠላ ነው የባለጠጋ ወዳጆች ግን ብዙዎች ናቸው።

verses.en: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
verses.fr: Celui qui méprise son prochain commet un péché, Mais heureux celui qui a pitié des misérables!
verses.am: ባልንጀራውን የሚንቅ ይበድላል ለድሀ ግን የሚራራ ምስጉ ነው።

verses.en: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
verses.fr: Ceux qui méditent le mal ne s''égarent-ils pas? Mais ceux qui méditent le bien agissent avec bonté et fidélité.
verses.am: ክፉ የሚያደርጉ ይስታሉ፤ ምሕረትና እውነት ግን መልካምን ለሚያደርጉ ናቸው።

verses.en: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
verses.fr: Tout travail procure l''abondance, Mais les paroles en l''air ne mènent qu''à la disette.
verses.am: በድካም ሁሉ ልምላሜ ይገኛል፤ ብዙ ነገር በሚናገር ከንፈር ግን ድህነት ብቻ አለ።

verses.en: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
verses.fr: La richesse est une couronne pour les sages; La folie des insensés est toujours de la folie.
verses.am: የጠቢባን ዘውድ ባለጠግነታቸው ነው፤ የሰነፎች ስንፍና ግን ስንፍና ነው።

verses.en: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
verses.fr: Le témoin véridique délivre des âmes, Mais le trompeur dit des mensonges.
verses.am: እውነተኛ ምስክር ነፍሶችን ያድናል፤ በሐሰት የሚናገር ግን ሸንጋይ ነው።

verses.en: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
verses.fr: Celui qui craint l''Eternel possède un appui ferme, Et ses enfants ont un refuge auprès de lui.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ለሚፈራ ጠንካራ መታመን አለው፥ ለልጆቹም መጠጊያ ይኖራል።

verses.en: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.fr: La crainte de l''Eternel est une source de vie, Pour détourner des pièges de la mort.
verses.am: ሰው ከሞት ወጥመድ ያመልጥ ዘድን እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት የሕይወት ምንጭ ነው።

verses.en: In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
verses.fr: Quand le peuple est nombreux, c''est la gloire d''un roi; Quand le peuple manque, c''est la ruine du prince.
verses.am: የንጉሥ ክብር በሕዝብ ብዛት ነው፤ በሰው ጥቂትነት ግን የገዥ ጥፋት አለ።

verses.en: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
verses.fr: Celui qui est lent à la colère a une grande intelligence, Mais celui qui est prompt à s''emporter proclame sa folie.
verses.am: ለትግሥተኛ ሰው ብዙ ማስተዋል አለው፤ ቍጡ ግን ስንፍናውን ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
verses.fr: Un coeur calme est la vie du corps, Mais l''envie est la carie des os.
verses.am: ትሑት ልብ የሥጋ ሕይወት ነው፤ ቅንዓት ግን አጥንትን ያነቅዛል።

verses.en: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
verses.fr: Opprimer le pauvre, c''est outrager celui qui l''a fait; Mais avoir pitié de l''indigent, c''est l''honorer.
verses.am: ድሀን የሚያስጨንቅ ፈጣሪውን ይሰድባል፤ ለድሀ ምሕረትን የሚያደርግ ግን ያከብረዋል።

verses.en: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
verses.fr: Le méchant est renversé par sa méchanceté, Mais le juste trouve un refuge même en sa mort.
verses.am: ኀጥእ በክፋቱ ይደፋል፤ ጻድቅ ግን በእውነቱ ይታመናል።

verses.en: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
verses.fr: Dans un coeur intelligent repose la sagesse, Mais au milieu des insensés elle se montre à découvert.
verses.am: በአዋቂ ልብ ጥበብ ትቀመጣለች፤ በሰነፎች ውስጥ ግን አትታወቅም።

verses.en: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
verses.fr: La justice élève une nation, Mais le péché est la honte des peuples.
verses.am: ጽድቅ ሕዝብን ከፍ ከፍ ታደርጋለች፤ ኃጢአት ግን ሕዝብን ታስነውራለች።

verses.en: The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
verses.fr: La faveur du roi est pour le serviteur prudent, Et sa colère pour celui qui fait honte.
verses.am: አስተዋይ አገልጋይ በንጉሥ ዘንድ ይወደዳል፤ በሚያሳፍር ላይ ግን ቍጣው ይሆናል።

verses.en: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
verses.fr: Une réponse douce calme la fureur, Mais une parole dure excite la colère.
verses.am: የለዘበች መልስ ቍጣን ትመልሳለች ሸካራ ቃል ግን ቍጣን ታስነሣለች።

verses.en: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
verses.fr: La langue des sages rend la science aimable, Et la bouche des insensés répand la folie.
verses.am: የጠቢባን ምላስ እውቀትን ያሳምራል፤ የሰነፎች አፍ ግን ስንፍናን ያፈልቃል።

verses.en: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
verses.fr: Les yeux de l''Eternel sont en tout lieu, Observant les méchants et les bons.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ዓይኖች በስፍራ ሁሉ ናቸው፤ ክፉዎችንና ደጎችን ይመለከታሉ።

verses.en: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
verses.fr: La langue douce est un arbre de vie, Mais la langue perverse brise l''âme.
verses.am: ፈዋሽ ምላስ የሕይወት ዛፍ ነው፤ የጠማማ ምላስ ግን ነፍስን ይሰብራል።

verses.en: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
verses.fr: L''insensé dédaigne l''instruction de son père, Mais celui qui a égard à la réprimande agit avec prudence.
verses.am: ሰነፍ የአባቱን ተግሣጽ ይንቃል፤ ዘለፋን የሚቀበል ግን አእምሮው የበዛ ነው።

verses.en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
verses.fr: Il y a grande abondance dans la maison du juste, Mais il y a du trouble dans les profits du méchant.
verses.am: በጻድቅ ሰው ቤት ብዙ ኃይል አለ፤ የኃጥእ ሰው መዝገብ ግን ሁከት ነው።

verses.en: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
verses.fr: Les lèvres des sages répandent la science, Mais le coeur des insensés n''est pas droit.
verses.am: የጠቢባን ከንፈር እውቀትን ትዘራለች፤ የሰነፎች ልብ ግን እንዲህ አይደለም።

verses.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
verses.fr: Le sacrifice des méchants est en horreur à l''Eternel, Mais la prière des hommes droits lui est agréable.
verses.am: የኅጥኣን መሥዋዕት በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አስጸያፊ ነው፤ የቅኖች ጸሎት ግን በእርሱ ዘንድ የተወደደ ነው።

verses.en: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the Lord: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
verses.fr: La voie du méchant est en horreur à l''Eternel, Mais il aime celui qui poursuit la justice.
verses.am: የኅጥኣን መንገድ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አስጸያፊ ነው፤ እርሱ ግን ጽድቅን የሚከተል ይወድዳል።

verses.en: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
verses.fr: Une correction sévère menace celui qui abandonne le sentier; Celui qui hait la réprimande mourra.
verses.am: ክፉ መቅሠፍት መንገድን በተወ ሰው ላይ ይመጣል፥ ዘለፋንም የሚጠላ ይሞታል።

verses.en: Hell and destruction are before the Lord: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
verses.fr: Le séjour des morts et l''abîme sont devant l''Eternel; Combien plus les coeurs des fils de l''homme!
verses.am: ሲኦልና ጥፋት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የታወቁ ናቸው፤ ይልቁንም የሰዎች ልብ የታወቀ ነው።

verses.en: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
verses.fr: Le moqueur n''aime pas qu''on le reprenne, Il ne va point vers les sages.
verses.am: ፌዘኛ ሰው የሚዘልፈውን አይወድድም፥ ወደ ጠቢባንም አይሄድም።

verses.en: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
verses.fr: Un coeur joyeux rend le visage serein; Mais quand le coeur est triste, l''esprit est abattu.
verses.am: ደስ ያለው ልብ ፊትን ያበራል፤ በልብ ኀዘን ግን ነፍስ ትሰበራለች።

verses.en: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
verses.fr: Un coeur intelligent cherche la science, Mais la bouche des insensés se plaît à la folie.
verses.am: የአዋቂ ልብ እውቀትን ይፈልጋል፤ የሰነፎች አፍ ግን በስንፍና ይሰማራል።

verses.en: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
verses.fr: Tous les jours du malheureux sont mauvais, Mais le coeur content est un festin perpétuel.
verses.am: ልቡ የሚያዝን ሰው ዘመኑ ሁሉ የከፋች ናት፤ የልብ ደስታ ግን ሁልጊዜ እንደ ግብዣ ነው።

verses.en: Better is little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure and trouble therewith.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut peu, avec la crainte de l''Eternel, Qu''un grand trésor, avec le trouble.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ከመፍራት ጋር ያለ ጥቂት ነገር ሁከት ካለበት ከብዙ መዝገብ ይሻላል።

verses.en: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut de l''herbe pour nourriture, là où règne l''amour, Qu''un boeuf engraissé, si la haine est là.
verses.am: የጐመን ወጥ በፍቅር መብላት የሰባ ፍሪዳን ጥል ባለበት ዘንድ ከመብላት ይሻላል።

verses.en: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
verses.fr: Un homme violent excite des querelles, Mais celui qui est lent à la colère apaise les disputes.
verses.am: ቍጡ ሰው ጠብን ያነሣሣል፤ ትዕግሥተኛ ሰው ግን ጸጥ ያሰኘዋል።

verses.en: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
verses.fr: Le chemin du paresseux est comme une haie d''épines, Mais le sentier des hommes droits est aplani.
verses.am: የታካች መንገድ እንደ እሾህ አጥር ናት፤ የጻድቃን መንገድ ግን የተደላደለች ናት።

verses.en: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
verses.fr: Un fils sage fait la joie de son père, Et un homme insensé méprise sa mère.
verses.am: ጠቢብ ልጅ አባቱን ደስ ያሰኛል፤ ሰነፍ ልጅ ግን እናቱን ይንቃል።

verses.en: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
verses.fr: La folie est une joie pour celui qui est dépourvu de sens, Mais un homme intelligent va le droit chemin.
verses.am: ልብ ለሌለው ሰው ስንፍና ደስታ ናት፤ አስተዋይ ግን አካሄዱን ያቀናል።

verses.en: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
verses.fr: Les projets échouent, faute d''une assemblée qui délibère; Mais ils réussissent quand il y a de nombreux conseillers.
verses.am: ምክር ከሌለች ዘንድ የታሰበው ሳይሳካ ይቀራል፤ መካሮች በበዙበት ዘንድ ግን ይጸናል።

verses.en: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
verses.fr: On éprouve de la joie à donner une réponse de sa bouche; Et combien est agréable une parole dite à propos!
verses.am: ሰው በአፉ መልስ ደስ ይለዋል፤ ቃልም በጊዜው ምንኛ መልካም ነው!

verses.en: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
verses.fr: Pour le sage, le sentier de la vie mène en haut, Afin qu''il se détourne du séjour des morts qui est en bas.
verses.am: በታች ካለው ከሲኦል ያመልጥ ዘንድ የሕይወት መንገድ አስተዋዩን ሰው ወደ ላይ ይወስደዋል።

verses.en: The Lord will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
verses.fr: L''Eternel renverse la maison des orgueilleux, Mais il affermit les bornes de la veuve.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የትዕቢተኞች ቤት ይነቅላል፤ የባልቴትን ዳርቻ ግን ያጸናል።

verses.en: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
verses.fr: Les pensées mauvaises sont en horreur à l''Eternel, Mais les paroles agréables sont pures à ses yeux.
verses.am: የበደለኛ አሳብ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አስጸያፊ ናት፤ ያማረ ቃል ግን ጥሩ ነው።

verses.en: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
verses.fr: Celui qui est avide de gain trouble sa maison, Mais celui qui hait les présents vivra.
verses.am: ትርፍ ለማግኘት የሚሳሳ ሰው የራሱን ቤት ያውካል፤ መማለጃን የሚጠላ ግን በሕይወት ይኖራል።

verses.en: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
verses.fr: Le coeur du juste médite pour répondre, Mais la bouche des méchants répand des méchancetés.
verses.am: የጻድቅ ልብ መልሱን ያስባል የኅጥኣን አፍ ግን ክፋትን ያፈልቃል።

verses.en: The Lord is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
verses.fr: L''Eternel s''éloigne des méchants, Mais il écoute la prière des justes.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከኅጥኣን ይርቃል፤ የጻድቃንን ጸሎት ግን ይሰማል።

verses.en: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
verses.fr: Ce qui plaît aux yeux réjouit le coeur; Une bonne nouvelle fortifie les membres.
verses.am: የዓይን ብርሃን ልብን ደስ ያሰኛል፥ መልካም ወሬም አጥንትን ያለመልማል።

verses.en: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
verses.fr: L''oreille attentive aux réprimandes qui mènent à la vie Fait son séjour au milieu des sages.
verses.am: የሕይወትን ተግሣጽ የሚሰማ ጆሮ በጠቢባን መካከል ይኖራል።

verses.en: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
verses.fr: Celui qui rejette la correction méprise son âme, Mais celui qui écoute la réprimande acquiert l''intelligence.
verses.am: ተግሣጽን ቸል የሚል የራሱን ነፍስ ይንቃል፤ ዘለፋን የሚሰማ ግን አእምሮ ያገኛል።

verses.en: The fear of the Lord is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
verses.fr: La crainte de l''Eternel enseigne la sagesse, Et l''humilité précède la gloire.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት የጥበብ ትምህርት ነው፤ ትሕትናም ክብረትን ትቀድማለች።

verses.en: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the Lord.
verses.fr: Les projets que forme le coeur dépendent de l''homme, Mais la réponse que donne la bouche vient de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የልብ መዘጋጀት ከሰው ነው፤ የምላስ መልስ ግን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the Lord weigheth the spirits.
verses.fr: Toutes les voies de l''homme sont pures à ses yeux; Mais celui qui pèse les esprits, c''est l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሰው መንገድ ሁሉ በዓይኖቹ ፊት ንጹሕ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን መንፈስን ይመዝናል።

verses.en: Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.
verses.fr: Recommande à l''Eternel tes oeuvres, Et tes projets réussiront.
verses.am: ሥራህን ለእግዚአብሔር አደራ ስጥ፥ አሳብህም ትጸናለች።

verses.en: The Lord hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a tout fait pour un but, Même le méchant pour le jour du malheur.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ለእርሱ ለራሱ ፈጠረ፥ ኀጥእን ደግሞ ለክፉ ቀን።

verses.en: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
verses.fr: Tout coeur hautain est en abomination à l''Eternel; Certes, il ne restera pas impuni.
verses.am: በልቡ የታበየ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው፥ እጅ በእጅም ሳይቀጣ አይቀርም።

verses.en: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the Lord men depart from evil.
verses.fr: Par la bonté et la fidélité on expie l''iniquité, Et par la crainte de l''Eternel on se détourne du mal.
verses.am: በምሕረትና በእውነት ኃጢአት ትሰረያለች፥ እግዚአብሔርንም በመፍራት ሰው ከክፋት ይመለሳል።

verses.en: When a man's ways please the Lord, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.fr: Quand l''Eternel approuve les voies d''un homme, Il dispose favorablement à son égard même ses ennemis.
verses.am: የሰው አካሄድ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ያሰኘው እንደ ሆነ፤ በእርሱና በጠላቶቹ መካከል ስንኳ ሰላምን ያደርጋል።

verses.en: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut peu, avec la justice, Que de grands revenus, avec l''injustice.
verses.am: በጽድቅ የሚገኝ ጥቂት ነገር በዓመፅ ከሚገኝ ከብዙ ትርፍ ይሻላል።

verses.en: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the Lord directeth his steps.
verses.fr: Le coeur de l''homme médite sa voie, Mais c''est l''Eternel qui dirige ses pas.
verses.am: የሰው ልብ መንገዱ ያዘጋጃል፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን አካሄዱን ያቀናለታል።

verses.en: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
verses.fr: Des oracles sont sur les lèvres du roi: Sa bouche ne doit pas être infidèle quand il juge.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ብይን በንጉሥ አፍ ነው፥ አፉም በፍርድ አይስትም።

verses.en: A just weight and balance are the Lord's: all the weights of the bag are his work.
verses.fr: Le poids et la balance justes sont à l''Eternel; Tous les poids du sac sont son ouvrage.
verses.am: እውነተኛ ሚዛንና መመዘኛ የእግዚአብሔር ናቸው፤ የከረጢት መመዘኛዎች ሁሉ የእርሱ ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.en: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.fr: Les rois ont horreur de faire le mal, Car c''est par la justice que le trône s''affermit.
verses.am: ግፍን መሥራት በንጉሥ ዘንድ ጸያፍ ነገር ነው፥ ዙፋን በጽድቅ ይጸናልና።

verses.en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
verses.fr: Les lèvres justes gagnent la faveur des rois, Et ils aiment celui qui parle avec droiture.
verses.am: የጽድቅ ከንፈር የነገሥታት ደስታ ናት፥ በቅን የሚናገር እርሱንም ይወድዱታል።

verses.en: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.fr: La fureur du roi est un messager de mort, Et un homme sage doit l''apaiser.
verses.am: የንጉሥ ቍጣ እንደ ሞት መልእክተኛ ነው፤ ጠቢብ ሰው ግን ያቈላምጠዋል።

verses.en: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.fr: La sérénité du visage du roi donne la vie, Et sa faveur est comme une pluie du printemps.
verses.am: በንጉሥ ፊት ብርሃን ዘንድ ሕይወት አለ፥ መልካም ፈቃዱም እንደ በልግ ዝናብ ደመና ነው።

verses.en: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
verses.fr: Combien acquérir la sagesse vaut mieux que l''or! Combien acquérir l''intelligence est préférable à l''argent!
verses.am: ጥበብን ማግኘት ምንኛ ከወርቅ ይሻላል! ማስተዋልንም ማግኘት ከብር ይልቅ የሚመረጥ ነው።

verses.en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
verses.fr: Le chemin des hommes droits, c''est d''éviter le mal; Celui qui garde son âme veille sur sa voie.
verses.am: የቅኖች መንገድ ከክፋት መራቅ ነው፤ መንገዱን የሚጠብቅ ነፍሱን ይጠብቃታል።

verses.en: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.fr: L''arrogance précède la ruine, Et l''orgueil précède la chute.
verses.am: ትዕቢት ጥፋትን፥ ኵሩ መንፈስም ውድቀትን ይቀድማል።

verses.en: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut être humble avec les humbles Que de partager le butin avec les orgueilleux.
verses.am: ከዕቡያን ጋር ምርኮ ከመካፈል ከትሑታን ጋር በተዋረደ መንፈስ መሆን ይሻላል።

verses.en: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the Lord, happy is he.
verses.fr: Celui qui réfléchit sur les choses trouve le bonheur, Et celui qui se confie en l''Eternel est heureux.
verses.am: ቃልን የሚያዳምጥ መልካም ነገርን ያገኛል፤ በእግዚአብሔር የታመነ ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
verses.fr: Celui qui est sage de coeur est appelé intelligent, Et la douceur des lèvres augmente le savoir.
verses.am: ልቡ ጠቢብ የሆነ አስተዋይ ይባላል፥ በከንፈሩም ጣፋጭ የሆነ ትምህርትን ያበዛል።

verses.en: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
verses.fr: La sagesse est une source de vie pour celui qui la possède; Et le châtiment des insensés, c''est leur folie.
verses.am: ገንዘብ ላደረገው ሰው እውቀት የሕይወት ምንጭ ነው፤ ስንፍና ግን የሰነፎች ቅጣት ነው።

verses.en: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
verses.fr: Celui qui est sage de coeur manifeste la sagesse par sa bouche, Et l''accroissement de son savoir paraît sur ses lèvres.
verses.am: የጠቢብ ልብ አፉን ያስተምራል፥ ለከንፈሩም ትምህርትን ይጨምራል።

verses.en: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.fr: Les paroles agréables sont un rayon de miel, Douces pour l''âme et salutaires pour le corps.
verses.am: ያማረ ቃል የማር ወለላ ነው፤ ለነፍስ ጣፋጭ ለአጥንትም ጤና ነው።

verses.en: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.fr: Telle voie paraît droite à un homme, Mais son issue, c''est la voie de la mort.
verses.am: ለሰው ቅን የምትመስል መንገድ አለች፤ ፍጻሜዋ ግን የሞት መንገድ ነው።

verses.en: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
verses.fr: Celui qui travaille, travaille pour lui, Car sa bouche l''y excite.
verses.am: የሠራተኛ ራብ ለእርሱ ይሠራል፥ አፉ ይጐተጕተዋልና።

verses.en: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
verses.fr: L''homme pervers prépare le malheur, Et il y a sur ses lèvres comme un feu ardent.
verses.am: ምናምንቴ ሰው ክፋትን ይምሳል፥ በከንፈሩም የሚቃጠል እሳት አለ።

verses.en: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
verses.fr: L''homme pervers excite des querelles, Et le rapporteur divise les amis.
verses.am: ጠማማ ሰው ጥልን ይዘራል፤ ጆሮ ጠቢ ሰው የተማመኑትን ወዳጆች ይለያያል።

verses.en: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
verses.fr: L''homme violent séduit son prochain, Et le fait marcher dans une voie qui n''est pas bonne.
verses.am: ግፈኛ ሰው ወዳጁን ያባብላል፥ መልካምም ወዳይደለ መንገድ ይመራዋል።

verses.en: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
verses.fr: Celui qui ferme les yeux pour se livrer à des pensées perverses, Celui qui se mord les lèvres, a déjà consommé le mal.
verses.am: ዓይኑን የሚዘጋ ጠማማ አሳብን ያስባል፤ ከንፈሩን የሚነክስ ክፋትን ይፈጽማል።

verses.en: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
verses.fr: Les cheveux blancs sont une couronne d''honneur; C''est dans le chemin de la justice qu''on la trouve.
verses.am: የሸበተ ጠጕር የክብር ዘውድ ነው፥ እርሱም በጽድቅ መንገድ ይገኛል።

verses.en: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
verses.fr: Celui qui est lent à la colère vaut mieux qu''un héros, Et celui qui est maître de lui-même, que celui qui prend des villes.
verses.am: ትዕግሥተኛ ሰው ከኃያል ሰው ይሻላል፥ በመንፈሱም ላይ የሚገዛ ከተማ ከሚወስዱ ይበልጣል።

verses.en: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the Lord.
verses.fr: On jette le sort dans le pan de la robe, Mais toute décision vient de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ዕጣ በጕያ ይጣላል፤ መደብዋ ሁሉ ግን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut un morceau de pain sec, avec la paix, Qu''une maison pleine de viandes, avec des querelles.
verses.am: ጥል ባለበት ዘንድ እርድ ከሞላበት ቤት በጸጥታ ደረቅ ቍራሽ ይሻላል።

verses.en: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
verses.fr: Un serviteur prudent domine sur le fils qui fait honte, Et il aura part à l''héritage au milieu des frères.
verses.am: አስተዋይ ባሪያ ነውረኛውን ልጅ ይገዛል፥ በወንድማማች መካከልም ርስትን ይካፈላል።

verses.en: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the Lord trieth the hearts.
verses.fr: Le creuset est pour l''argent, et le fourneau pour l''or; Mais celui qui éprouve les coeurs, c''est l''Eternel.
verses.am: ማቅለጫ ለብር፥ ከውር ለወርቅ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ልብን ይፈትናል።

verses.en: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
verses.fr: Le méchant est attentif à la lèvre inique, Le menteur prête l''oreille à la langue pernicieuse.
verses.am: ክፉ ሰው የበደለኛን ከንፈር ይሰማል፤ ሐሰተኛም ወደ ተንኰለኛ ምላስ ያደምጣል።

verses.en: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
verses.fr: Celui qui se moque du pauvre outrage celui qui l''a fait; Celui qui se réjouit d''un malheur ne restera pas impuni.
verses.am: በድሀ የሚያላግጥ ፈጣሪውን ይሰድባል፤ በጥፋትም ደስ የሚለው ሳይቀጣ አይቀርም።

verses.en: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
verses.fr: Les enfants des enfants sont la couronne des vieillards, Et les pères sont la gloire de leurs enfants.
verses.am: የሽማግሌዎች አክሊል የልጅ ልጆች ናቸው፤ የልጆችም ክብር አባቶቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
verses.fr: Les paroles distinguées ne conviennent pas à un insensé; Combien moins à un noble les paroles mensongères!
verses.am: ለሰነፍ የኵራት አነጋገር አይገባውም፤ ይልቁንም ሐሰተኛ ከንፈር ለመኰንን አይገባውም።

verses.en: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
verses.fr: Les présents sont une pierre précieuse aux yeux de qui en reçoit; De quelque côté qu''ils se tournent, ils ont du succès.
verses.am: ገንዘብ ባደረገው ፊት መማለጃ እንደ ተዋበ ዕንቍ ነው፥ ወደ ዞረበትም ስፍራ ሁሉ ሥራውን ያቀናል።

verses.en: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
verses.fr: Celui qui couvre une faute cherche l''amour, Et celui qui la rappelle dans ses discours divise les amis.
verses.am: ኃጢአትን የሚከድን ሰው ፍቅርን ይሻል፤ ነገርን የሚደጋግም ግን የተማመኑትን ወዳጆቹን ይለያያል።

verses.en: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
verses.fr: Une réprimande fait plus d''impression sur l''homme intelligent Que cent coups sur l''insensé.
verses.am: መቶ ግርፋት በሰነፍ ጠልቆ ከሚገባ ይልቅ ተግሣጽ በአስተዋይ ሰው ጠልቆ ወደ ልቡ ይገባል።

verses.en: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.fr: Le méchant ne cherche que révolte, Mais un messager cruel sera envoyé contre lui.
verses.am: ክፉ ሰው ዓመፃን ብቻ ይሻል፤ ስለዚህ ጨካኝ መልአክ ይላክበታል።

verses.en: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.fr: Rencontre une ourse privée de ses petits, Plutôt qu''un insensé pendant sa folie.
verses.am: ሰነፍን በስንፍናው ከመገናኘት ልጆችዋ የተነጠቁባትን ድብ መገናኘት ይሻላል።

verses.en: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.fr: De celui qui rend le mal pour le bien Le mal ne quittera point la maison.
verses.am: በመልካም ፋንታ ክፉን የሚመልስ፥ ክፉ ነገር ከቤቱ አትርቅም።

verses.en: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
verses.fr: Commencer une querelle, c''est ouvrir une digue; Avant que la dispute s''anime, retire-toi.
verses.am: የጠብ መጀመሪያ እንደ ውኃ አፈሳሰስ ነው፤ ስለዚህ ጠብ ሳይበረታ አንተ ክርክርን ተው።

verses.en: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the Lord.
verses.fr: Celui qui absout le coupable et celui qui condamne le juste Sont tous deux en abomination à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ኀጥኡን የሚያጸድቅና በጻድቁ ላይ የሚፈርድ፥ ሁለቱ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አስጸያፊዎች ናቸው።

verses.en: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?
verses.fr: A quoi sert l''argent dans la main de l''insensé? A acheter la sagesse?... Mais il n''a point de sens.
verses.am: በሰነፍ እጅ የጥበብ መግዣ ገንዘብ መኖሩ ስለ ምንድር ነው? ጥበብን ይገዛ ዘንድ አእምሮ የለውምና።

verses.en: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.fr: L''ami aime en tout temps, Et dans le malheur il se montre un frère.
verses.am: ወዳጅ በዘመኑ ሁሉ ይወድዳል፤ ወንድምም ለመከራ ይወለዳል።

verses.en: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
verses.fr: L''homme dépourvu de sens prend des engagements, Il cautionne son prochain.
verses.am: አእምሮ የጐደለው ሰው አጋና ይመታል፥ በባልንጀራውም ፊት ይዋሳል።

verses.en: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
verses.fr: Celui qui aime les querelles aime le péché; Celui qui élève sa porte cherche la ruine.
verses.am: ዓመፃን የሚወድድ ክርክርን ይወድዳል፤ ደጁንም ዘለግ የሚያደርግ ውድቀትን ይሻል።

verses.en: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
verses.fr: Un coeur faux ne trouve pas le bonheur, Et celui dont la langue est perverse tombe dans le malheur.
verses.am: ጠማማ ልብ ያለው መልካምን አያገኝም፥ ምላሱንም የሚገለብጥ በክፉ ላይ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
verses.fr: Celui qui donne naissance à un insensé aura du chagrin; Le père d''un fou ne peut pas se réjouir.
verses.am: ሰነፍን የሚወልድ ኀዘን ይሆንበታል፥ የደንቆሮ ልጅም አባት ደስ አይለውም።

verses.en: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
verses.fr: Un coeur joyeux est un bon remède, Mais un esprit abattu dessèche les os.
verses.am: ደስ ያላት ልብ መልካም መድኃኒት ናት፤ ያዘነች ነፍስ ግን አጥንትን ታደርቃለች።

verses.en: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
verses.fr: Le méchant accepte en secret des présents, Pour pervertir les voies de la justice.
verses.am: ኀጥእ የፍርድን መንገድ ለማጥመም ከብብት መማለጃን ይወስዳል።

verses.en: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
verses.fr: La sagesse est en face de l''homme intelligent, Mais les yeux de l''insensé sont à l''extrémité de la terre.
verses.am: በአስተዋይ ፊት ጥበብ ትኖራለች፤ የሰነፍ ዓይን ግን በምድር ዳርቻ ነው።

verses.en: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
verses.fr: Un fils insensé fait le chagrin de son père, Et l''amertume de celle qui l''a enfanté.
verses.am: ሰነፍ ልጅ ለአባቱ ፀፀት ነው፥ ለወለደችውም ምሬት ነው።

verses.en: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
verses.fr: Il n''est pas bon de condamner le juste à une amende, Ni de frapper les nobles à cause de leur droiture.
verses.am: ጻድቅን መቅጣት፥ ጨዋ ሰውንም በጻድቅነቱ መምታት መልካም አይደለም።

verses.en: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
verses.fr: Celui qui retient ses paroles connaît la science, Et celui qui a l''esprit calme est un homme intelligent.
verses.am: ጥቂት ቃልን የሚናገር አዋቂ ነው፥ መንፈሱም ቀዝቃዛ የሆነ አስተዋይ ነው።

verses.en: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
verses.fr: L''insensé même, quand il se tait, passe pour sage; Celui qui ferme ses lèvres est un homme intelligent.
verses.am: ሰነፍ ዝም ቢል ጠቢብ ሆኖ ይቈጠራል፥ ከንፈሩንም የሚቈልፍ። ባለ አእምሮ ነው ይባላል።

verses.en: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
verses.fr: Celui qui se tient à l''écart cherche ce qui lui plaît, Il s''irrite contre tout ce qui est sage.
verses.am: መለየት የሚወድድ ምኞቱን ይከተላል፥ መልካሙንም ጥበብ ሁሉ ይቃወማል።

verses.en: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas à l''intelligence que l''insensé prend plaisir, C''est à la manifestation de ses pensées.
verses.am: ሰነፍ የጥበብን ነገር አይወድድም፤ በልቡ ያለውን ሁሉ መግለጥ ብቻ ይወድዳል እንጂ።

verses.en: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
verses.fr: Quand vient le méchant, vient aussi le mépris; Et avec la honte, vient l''opprobre.
verses.am: ኀጥእ በመጣ ጊዜ ንቀት ደግሞ ይመጣል፥ ነውርም ከስድብ ጋር።

verses.en: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
verses.fr: Les paroles de la bouche d''un homme sont des eaux profondes; La source de la sagesse est un torrent qui jaillit.
verses.am: የሰው አፍ ቃል የጠለቀ ውኃ ነው፥ የጥበብም ምንጭ ፈሳሽ ወንዝ ነው።

verses.en: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
verses.fr: Il n''est pas bon d''avoir égard à la personne du méchant, Pour faire tort au juste dans le jugement.
verses.am: የጻድቅ ፍርድ ይጠምም ዘንድ፥ ለኀጥእም ማድላት መልካም አይደለም።

verses.en: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.
verses.fr: Les lèvres de l''insensé se mêlent aux querelles, Et sa bouche provoque les coups.
verses.am: የሰነፍ ከንፈር በጥል ውስጥ ትገባለች፥ አፉም በትርን ትጠራለች።

verses.en: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
verses.fr: La bouche de l''insensé cause sa ruine, Et ses lèvres sont un piège pour son âme.
verses.am: የሰነፍ አፍ ለራሱ ጥፋት ነው፥ ከንፈሩም ለነፍሱ ወጥመድ ነው።

verses.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.fr: Les paroles du rapporteur sont comme des friandises, Elles descendent jusqu''au fond des entrailles.
verses.am: የጆሮ ጠቢ ቃል እንደ ጣፋጭ መብል ነው፥ እርሱም እስከ ሆድ ጕርጆች ድረስ ይወርዳል።

verses.en: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
verses.fr: Celui qui se relâche dans son travail Est frère de celui qui détruit.
verses.am: በሥራው ታካች የሚሆን የሀብት አጥፊ ወንድም ነው።

verses.en: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
verses.fr: Le nom de l''Eternel est une tour forte; Le juste s''y réfugie, et se trouve en sûreté.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ስም የጸና ግምብ ነው፤ ጻድቅ ወደ እርሱ ሮጦ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
verses.fr: La fortune est pour le riche une ville forte; Dans son imagination, c''est une haute muraille.
verses.am: ለባለጠጋ ሰው ሀብቱ እንደ ጸናች ከተማ ናት፥ በአሳቡም እንደ ረጅም ቅጥር።

verses.en: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
verses.fr: Avant la ruine, le coeur de l''homme s''élève; Mais l''humilité précède la gloire.
verses.am: ሰው ሳይወድቅ በፊት ልቡ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፥ ትሕትናም ክብረትን ትቀድማለች።

verses.en: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
verses.fr: Celui qui répond avant d''avoir écouté Fait un acte de folie et s''attire la confusion.
verses.am: ሳይሰማ ነገርን በሚመልስ ስንፍናና እፍረት ይሆንበታል።

verses.en: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
verses.fr: L''esprit de l''homme le soutient dans la maladie; Mais l''esprit abattu, qui le relèvera?
verses.am: የሰው ነፍስ ሕመሙን ይታገሣል፤ የተቀጠቀጠን መንፈስ ግን ማን ያጠንክረዋል?

verses.en: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
verses.fr: Un coeur intelligent acquiert la science, Et l''oreille des sages cherche la science.
verses.am: የአስተዋይ ልብ እውቀትን ያገኛል፥ የጠቢባንም ጆሮ እውቀትን ትፈልጋለች።

verses.en: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
verses.fr: Les présents d''un homme lui élargissent la voie, Et lui donnent accès auprès des grands.
verses.am: የሰው ስጦታ መንገዱን ታሰፋለታለች፥ በታላላቆችም ፊት ታገባዋለች።

verses.en: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
verses.fr: Le premier qui parle dans sa cause paraît juste; Vient sa partie adverse, et on l''examine.
verses.am: ወደ ፍርድ አስቀድሞ የገባ ጻድቅ ይመስላል፤ ባልንጀራው ግን መጥቶ ይመረምረዋል።

verses.en: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
verses.fr: Le sort fait cesser les contestations, Et décide entre les puissants.
verses.am: ዕጣ ክርክርን ትከለክላለች፥ በኃያላንም መካከል ትበይናለች።

verses.en: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
verses.fr: Des frères sont plus intraitables qu''une ville forte, Et leurs querelles sont comme les verrous d''un palais.
verses.am: የተበደለ ወንድም እንደ ጸናች ከተማ ጽኑ ነው፤ ክርክራቸውም እንደ ግንብ ብረት ነው።

verses.en: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
verses.fr: C''est du fruit de sa bouche que l''homme rassasie son corps, C''est du produit de ses lèvres qu''il se rassasie.
verses.am: የሰው ሆድ ከአፉ ፍሬ ይሞላል ከንፈሩም ከሚያፈራው ይጠግባል።

verses.en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
verses.fr: La mort et la vie sont au pouvoir de la langue; Quiconque l''aime en mangera les fruits.
verses.am: ሞትና ሕይወት በምላስ እጅ ናቸው፤ የሚወድዱአትም ፍሬዋን ይበላሉ።

verses.en: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the Lord.
verses.fr: Celui qui trouve une femme trouve le bonheur; C''est une grâce qu''il obtient de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሚስት ያገኘ በረከትን አገኘ፥ ከእግዚአብሔርም ሞገስን ይቀበላል።

verses.en: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
verses.fr: Le pauvre parle en suppliant, Et le riche répond avec dureté.
verses.am: ድሀ በትሕትና እየለመነ ይናገራል፤ ባለጠጋ ግን በድፍረት ይመልሳል።

verses.en: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
verses.fr: Celui qui a beaucoup d''amis les a pour son malheur, Mais il est tel ami plus attaché qu''un frère.
verses.am: ብዙ ወዳጆች ያሉት ሰው ይጠፋል፤ ነገር ግን ከወንድም አብልጦ የሚጠጋጋ ወዳጅ አለ።

verses.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut le pauvre qui marche dans son intégrité, Que l''homme qui a des lèvres perverses et qui est un insensé.
verses.am: በከንፈሩ ከሚወሳልት ሰነፍ ይልቅ ያለ ነውር የሚሄድ ድሀ ይሻላል።

verses.en: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
verses.fr: Le manque de science n''est bon pour personne, Et celui qui précipite ses pas tombe dans le péché.
verses.am: ነፍስ እውቀት የሌለባት ትሆን ዘንድ መልካም አይደለም፤ እግሩንም የሚያፈጥን ከመንገድ ይስታል።

verses.en: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the Lord.
verses.fr: La folie de l''homme pervertit sa voie, Et c''est contre l''Eternel que son coeur s''irrite.
verses.am: የሰው ስንፍና መንገዱን ታጣምምበታለች፤ ልቡም በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ይቈጣል።

verses.en: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
verses.fr: La richesse procure un grand nombre d''amis, Mais le pauvre est séparé de son ami.
verses.am: ባለጠግነት ብዙ ወዳጆች ይጨምራል፤ የድሀ ወዳጅ ግን ከእርሱ ይርቃል።

verses.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
verses.fr: Le faux témoin ne restera pas impuni, Et celui qui dit des mensonges n''échappera pas.
verses.am: ሐሰተኛ ምስክር ሳይቀጣ አይቀርም፥ በሐሰትም የሚናገር አያመልጥም።

verses.en: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
verses.fr: Beaucoup de gens flattent l''homme généreux, Et tous sont les amis de celui qui fait des présents.
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎች ለጋሱን ያቈላምጣሉ፥ ስጦታ ለሚሰጥም ሁሉ ወዳጅ ነው።

verses.en: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
verses.fr: Tous les frères du pauvre le haïssent; Combien plus ses amis s''éloignent-ils de lui! Il leur adresse des paroles suppliantes, mais ils disparaissent.
verses.am: ድሀን ሰው ወንድሞቹ ሁሉ ይጠሉታል፤ ይልቁንም ወዳጆቹ ከእርሱ ይርቃሉ። እነርሱንም በቃል ቢከተላቸው አንዳች አይረቡትም።

verses.en: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
verses.fr: Celui qui acquiert du sens aime son âme; Celui qui garde l''intelligence trouve le bonheur.
verses.am: ጥበብን የሚያገኝ ነፍሱን ይወድዳል፥ ማስተዋልንም የሚጠብቅ መልካም ነገርን ያገኛል።

verses.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
verses.fr: Le faux témoin ne restera pas impuni, Et celui qui dit des mensonges périra.
verses.am: ሐሰተኛ ምስክር ሳይቀጣ አይቀርም፤ በሐሰትም የሚናገር ይጠፋል።

verses.en: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.fr: Il ne sied pas à un insensé de vivre dans les délices; Combien moins à un esclave de dominer sur des princes!
verses.am: ለሰነፍ ቅምጥልነት አይገባውም፥ ይልቁንም ባሪያ በአለቆች ላይ ይገዛ ዘንድ።

verses.en: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
verses.fr: L''homme qui a de la sagesse est lent à la colère, Et il met sa gloire à oublier les offenses.
verses.am: ሰውን ጠቢብ አእምሮው ከቍጣ ያዘገየዋል፥ ለበደለኛውም ይቅር ይል ዘንድ ክብር ይሆንለታል።

verses.en: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
verses.fr: La colère du roi est comme le rugissement d''un lion, Et sa faveur est comme la rosée sur l''herbe.
verses.am: እንደ አንበሳ ግሣት የንጉሥ ቍጣ ነው፥ ሞገሱም በመስክ ላይ እንዳለ ጠል ነው።

verses.en: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
verses.fr: Un fils insensé est une calamité pour son père, Et les querelles d''une femme sont une gouttière sans fin.
verses.am: ሰነፍ ልጅ ለአባቱ ኀዘን ነው፥ ጠበኛም ሚስት እንደማያቋርጥ ነጠብጣብ ናት።

verses.en: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the Lord.
verses.fr: On peut hériter de ses pères une maison et des richesses, Mais une femme intelligente est un don de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ቤትና ባለጠግነት ከአባቶች ዘንድ ይወረሳሉ፤ አስተዋይ ሚስት ግን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ናት።

verses.en: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.fr: La paresse fait tomber dans l''assoupissement, Et l''âme nonchalante éprouve la faim.
verses.am: ተግባር መፍታት እንቅልፍን ታመጣለች፥ የታካችም ነፍስ ትራባለች።

verses.en: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
verses.fr: Celui qui garde ce qui est commandé garde son âme; Celui qui ne veille pas sur sa voie mourra.
verses.am: ትእዛዝን የሚጠብቅ ነፍሱን ይጠብቃል፤ መንገዱን ቸል የሚል ግን ይጠፋል።

verses.en: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the Lord; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
verses.fr: Celui qui a pitié du pauvre prête à l''Eternel, Qui lui rendra selon son oeuvre.
verses.am: ለድሀ ቸርነትን የሚያደርግ ለእግዚአብሔር ያበድራል፥ በጎነቱንም መልሶ ይከፍለዋል።

verses.en: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
verses.fr: Châtie ton fils, car il y a encore de l''espérance; Mais ne désire point le faire mourir.
verses.am: ተስፋ ገና ሳለች ልጅህን ገሥጽ፥ መሞቱንም አትሻ።

verses.en: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
verses.fr: Celui que la colère emporte doit en subir la peine; Car si tu le libères, tu devras y revenir.
verses.am: ንዴተኛ ሰው መቀጮ ይከፍላል፤ ብታድነውም ደግሞ ትጨምራለህ።

verses.en: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
verses.fr: Ecoute les conseils, et reçois l''instruction, Afin que tu sois sage dans la suite de ta vie.
verses.am: ምክርን ስማ፥ ተግሣጽንም ተቀበል በፍጻሜህ ጠቢብ ትሆን ዘንድ።

verses.en: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the Lord, that shall stand.
verses.fr: Il y a dans le coeur de l''homme beaucoup de projets, Mais c''est le dessein de l''Eternel qui s''accomplit.
verses.am: በሰው ልብ ብዙ አሳብ አለ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ምክር ግን እርሱ ይጸናል።

verses.en: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
verses.fr: Ce qui fait le charme d''un homme, c''est sa bonté; Et mieux vaut un pauvre qu''un menteur.
verses.am: የሰው ቸርነት የእርሱ ፍሬ ነው፤ ከሐሰተኛ ባለጠጋም እውነተኛ ድሀ ይሻላል።

verses.en: The fear of the Lord tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
verses.fr: La crainte de l''Eternel mène à la vie, Et l''on passe la nuit rassasié, sans être visité par le malheur.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ወደ ሕይወት ይመራል፤ የሚፈራውም ጠግቦ ይኖራል፥ ክፉ ነገርም አያገኘውም።

verses.en: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.fr: Le paresseux plonge sa main dans le plat, Et il ne la ramène pas à sa bouche.
verses.am: ታካች ሰው እጁን በወጭቱ ያጠልቃታል፥ ወደ አፉ ስንኳ አይመልሳትም።

verses.en: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
verses.fr: Frappe le moqueur, et le sot deviendra sage; Reprends l''homme intelligent, et il comprendra la science.
verses.am: ፌዘኛ ብትገርፈው አላዋቂ ብልሃተኛ ይሆናል፤ አስተዋይን ሰው ብትገሥጸው እውቀትን ያገኛል።

verses.en: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
verses.fr: Celui qui ruine son père et qui met en fuite sa mère Est un fils qui fait honte et qui fait rougir.
verses.am: አባቱን የሚያስከፋ እናቱንም የሚያሳድድ የሚያሳፍርና ጐስቋላ ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
verses.fr: Cesse, mon fils, d''écouter l''instruction, Si c''est pour t''éloigner des paroles de la science.
verses.am: ልጅ ሆይ፥ ተግሣጽን ከሰማህ በኋላ ከእውቀት ቃል መሳሳትን ተው።

verses.en: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
verses.fr: Un témoin pervers se moque de la justice, Et la bouche des méchants dévore l''iniquité.
verses.am: ወስላታ ምስክር በፍርድ ያፌዛል፥ የኀጥኣንም አፍ ክፋትን ይውጣል።

verses.en: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
verses.fr: Les châtiments sont prêts pour les moqueurs, Et les coups pour le dos des insensés.
verses.am: ለሚያፌዙ ሰዎች ፍርድ ተዘጋጅታለች፥ ለሰነፎችም ጀርባ በትር።

verses.en: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
verses.fr: Le vin est moqueur, les boissons fortes sont tumultueuses; Quiconque en fait excès n''est pas sage.
verses.am: የወይን ጠጅ ፌዘኛ ያደርጋል፥ ብርቱ መጠጥም ጠበኛ ያደርጋል፤ በዚህም የሳተ ሁሉ ጠቢብ አይደለም።

verses.en: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
verses.fr: La terreur qu''inspire le roi est comme le rugissement d''un lion; Celui qui l''irrite pèche contre lui-même.
verses.am: የንጉሥ ቍጣ እንደ አንበሳ ግሣት ነው፤ የሚያስቈጣውም ሰው የራሱን ነፍስ ይበድላል።

verses.en: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
verses.fr: C''est une gloire pour l''homme de s''abstenir des querelles, Mais tout insensé se livre à l''emportement.
verses.am: ከክርክር ይርቅ ዘንድ ለሰው ክብሩ ነው፤ ሰነፍ ሁሉ ግን እንዲህ ባለ ነገር ይጣመራል።

verses.en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.fr: A cause du froid, le paresseux ne laboure pas; A la moisson, il voudrait récolter, mais il n''y a rien.
verses.am: ታካች ሰው በብርድ ምክንያት አያርስም፤ ስለዚህ በመከር ይለምናል፥ ምንም አያገኝም።

verses.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.fr: Les desseins dans le coeur de l''homme sont des eaux profondes, Mais l''homme intelligent sait y puiser.
verses.am: ምክር በሰው ልብ እንደ ጠሊቅ ውኃ ነው፤ አእምሮ ያለው ሰው ግን ይቀዳዋል።

verses.en: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
verses.fr: Beaucoup de gens proclament leur bonté; Mais un homme fidèle, qui le trouvera?
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎች ቸርነታቸውን ያወራሉ፤ የታመነውን ሰው ግን ማን ያገኘዋል?

verses.en: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
verses.fr: Le juste marche dans son intégrité; Heureux ses enfants après lui!
verses.am: ጻድቅ ያለ ነውር ይሄዳል፥ ልጆቹም ከእርሱ በኋላ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
verses.fr: Le roi assis sur le trône de la justice Dissipe tout mal par son regard.
verses.am: በፍርድ ወንበር የተቀመጠ ንጉሥ ክፉውን ሁሉ በዓይኖቹ ይበትናል።

verses.en: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
verses.fr: Qui dira: J''ai purifié mon coeur, Je suis net de mon péché?
verses.am: ልቤን አነጻሁ፥ ከኃጢአትም ጠራሁ የሚል ማን ነው?

verses.en: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the Lord.
verses.fr: Deux sortes de poids, deux sortes d''épha, Sont l''un et l''autre en abomination à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሁለት ዓይነት ሚዛንና ሁለት ዓይነት መስፈሪያ፥ ሁለቱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ርኩሳን ናቸው።

verses.en: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
verses.fr: L''enfant laisse déjà voir par ses actions Si sa conduite sera pure et droite.
verses.am: ሕፃን ቅንና ንጹሕ መሆኑ በሚያደርገው ሥራ ይታወቃል።

verses.en: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the Lord hath made even both of them.
verses.fr: L''oreille qui entend, et l''oeil qui voit, C''est l''Eternel qui les a faits l''un et l''autre.
verses.am: የሚሰማ ጆሮንና የሚያይ ዓይንን፥ ሁለቱን እግዚአብሔር ፈጠራቸው።

verses.en: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
verses.fr: N''aime pas le sommeil, de peur que tu ne deviennes pauvre; Ouvre les yeux, tu seras rassasié de pain.
verses.am: ድሀ እንዳትሆን እንቅልፍን አትውደድ፤ ዓይንህን ክፈት፥ እንጀራም ትጠግባለህ።

verses.en: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
verses.fr: Mauvais! mauvais! dit l''acheteur; Et en s''en allant, il se félicite.
verses.am: የሚገዛ ሰው። ክፉ ነው ክፉ ነው ይላል፤ በሄደ ጊዜ ግን ይመካል።

verses.en: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
verses.fr: Il y a de l''or et beaucoup de perles; Mais les lèvres savantes sont un objet précieux.
verses.am: ወርቅና ብዙ ቀይ ዕንቍ ይገኛል፤ የእውቀት ከንፈር ግን የከበረች ጌጥ ናት።

verses.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.fr: Prends son vêtement, car il a cautionné autrui; Exige de lui des gages, à cause des étrangers.
verses.am: ለማያውቀው ከተዋሰ ሰው ልብሱን ውሰድ፥ ለእንግዳ የተዋሰውንም እርሱን አግተው።

verses.en: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
verses.fr: Le pain du mensonge est doux à l''homme, Et plus tard sa bouche est remplie de gravier.
verses.am: የሐሰት እንጀራ ለሰው የጣፈጠ ነው፤ ከዚያ በኋላ ግን አፉ ጭንጫ ይሞላል።

verses.en: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
verses.fr: Les projets s''affermissent par le conseil; Fais la guerre avec prudence.
verses.am: አሳብ በምክር ትጸናለች፥ በመልካምም ምክር ሰልፍ አድርግ።

verses.en: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
verses.fr: Celui qui répand la calomnie dévoile les secrets; Ne te mêle pas avec celui qui ouvre ses lèvres.
verses.am: ዘዋሪ ሐሜተኛ ምሥጢርን ይገልጣል፤ ከንፈሩን የሚያሞጠሙጥ ሰውን አትገናኘው።

verses.en: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un maudit son père et sa mère, Sa lampe s''éteindra au milieu des ténèbres.
verses.am: አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚሰድብ፥ በጽቅድቅ ጨለማ መብራቱ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
verses.fr: Un héritage promptement acquis dès l''origine Ne sera pas béni quand viendra la fin.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያ ፈጥኖ የተከማቸ ርስት ፍጻሜው አይባረክም።

verses.en: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the Lord, and he shall save thee.
verses.fr: Ne dis pas: Je rendrai le mal. Espère en l''Eternel, et il te délivrera.
verses.am: ክፉ እመልሳለሁ አትበል፤ እግዚአብሔርን ተማመን፥ እርሱም ያድንሃል።

verses.en: Divers weights are an abomination unto the Lord; and a false balance is not good.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a en horreur deux sortes de poids, Et la balance fausse n''est pas une chose bonne.
verses.am: ሁለት ዓይነት ሚዛን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አስጸያፊ ነው፥ ሐሰተኛ ሚዛንም መልካም አይደለም።

verses.en: Man's goings are of the Lord; how can a man then understand his own way?
verses.fr: C''est l''Eternel qui dirige les pas de l''homme, Mais l''homme peut-il comprendre sa voie?
verses.am: የሰው አካሄዱ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው፤ እንግዲያስ ሰው መንገዱን እንዴት ያስተውላል?

verses.en: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
verses.fr: C''est un piège pour l''homme que de prendre à la légère un engagement sacré, Et de ne réfléchir qu''après avoir fait un voeu.
verses.am: ሰው በችኰላ። ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ነው ብሎ ቢሳል፥ ከተሳለም በኋላ ቢፀፀት ወጥመድ ነው።

verses.en: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
verses.fr: Un roi sage dissipe les méchants, Et fait passer sur eux la roue.
verses.am: ጠቢብ ንጉሥ ኀጥኣንን በመንሽ ይበትናቸዋል፥ መንኰራኵሩንም በእነርሱ ላይ ያንኰራኵርባቸዋል።

verses.en: The spirit of man is the candle of the Lord, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
verses.fr: Le souffle de l''homme est une lampe de l''Eternel; Il pénètre jusqu''au fond des entrailles.
verses.am: የሰው መንፈስ የእግዚአብሔር መብራት ነው የሆዱን ጕርጆች ሁሉ የሚመረምር።

verses.en: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
verses.fr: La bonté et la fidélité gardent le roi, Et il soutient son trône par la bonté.
verses.am: ቸርነትና እውነት ንጉሥን ይጠብቁታል፤ ዙፋኑም በቸርነት ይበረታል።

verses.en: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.
verses.fr: La force est la gloire des jeunes gens, Et les cheveux blancs sont l''ornement des vieillards.
verses.am: የጎበዛዝት ክብር ጕልበታቸው ናት፥ የሽማግሌዎችም ጌጥ ሽበት ነው።

verses.en: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
verses.fr: Les plaies d''une blessure sont un remède pour le méchant; De même les coups qui pénètrent jusqu''au fond des entrailles.
verses.am: የሰንበር ቍስል ክፉዎችን ያነጻል፤ ግርፋትም ወደ ሆድ ጕርጆች ይገባል።

verses.en: The king's heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
verses.fr: Le coeur du roi est un courant d''eau dans la main de l''Eternel; Il l''incline partout où il veut.
verses.am: የንጉሥ ልብ እንደ ውኃ ፈሳሾች በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ነው፤ ወደ ወደደውም ያዘነብለዋል።

verses.en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the Lord pondereth the hearts.
verses.fr: Toutes les voies de l''homme sont droites à ses yeux; Mais celui qui pèse les coeurs, c''est l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሰው መንገድ ሁሉ በዓይኑ ፊት የቀናች ትመስለዋለች፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ልብን ይመዝናል።

verses.en: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.
verses.fr: La pratique de la justice et de l''équité, Voilà ce que l''Eternel préfère aux sacrifices.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከመሥዋዕት ይልቅ ጽድቅንና ቅን ነገርን ማድረግ ይወድዳል።

verses.en: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
verses.fr: Des regards hautains et un coeur qui s''enfle, Cette lampe des méchants, ce n''est que péché.
verses.am: ትዕቢተኛ ዓይንና ደፋር ልብ የኀጥኣንም እርሻ ኃጢአት ነው።

verses.en: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
verses.fr: Les projets de l''homme diligent ne mènent qu''à l''abondance, Mais celui qui agit avec précipitation n''arrive qu''à la disette.
verses.am: የትጉህ አሳብ ወደ ጥጋብ ያደርሳል፤ ችኵል ሰው ሁሉ ግን ለመጕደል ይቸኩላል።

verses.en: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
verses.fr: Des trésors acquis par une langue mensongère Sont une vanité fugitive et l''avant-coureur de la mort.
verses.am: በሐሰተኛ ምላስ መዝገብ ማከማቸት የሚበንን ጉም ነው፤ ይህን የሚፈልጉ ሞትን ይፈልጋሉ።

verses.en: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
verses.fr: La violence des méchants les emporte, Parce qu''ils refusent de faire ce qui est juste.
verses.am: ቅን ነገርን ያደርጉ ዘንድ አይወድዱምና የኀጥኣን ንጥቂያ ራሳቸውን ያጠፋቸዋል።

verses.en: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
verses.fr: Le coupable suit des voies détournées, Mais l''innocent agit avec droiture.
verses.am: የበደለኛ መንገድ የጠመመች ናት፤ የንጹሕ ሥራ ግን የቀና ነው።

verses.en: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut habiter à l''angle d''un toit, Que de partager la demeure d''une femme querelleuse.
verses.am: ከጠበኛ ሴት ጋር በአንድ ቤት ከመቀመጥ በውጪ በቤት ማዕዘን ላይ መቀመጥ ይሻላል።

verses.en: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
verses.fr: L''âme du méchant désire le mal; Son ami ne trouve pas grâce à ses yeux.
verses.am: የኀጥእ ነፍስ ክፉን ትመኛለች፥ በፊቱም ባልንጀራው ሞገስን አያገኝም።

verses.en: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
verses.fr: Quand on châtie le moqueur, le sot devient sage; Et quand on instruit le sage, il accueille la science.
verses.am: ፌዘኛ ቅጣትን በተቀበለ ጊዜ አላዋቂ ሰው ጥበብን ያገኛል፤ ጠቢብም ቢማር እውቀትን ይቀበላል።

verses.en: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
verses.fr: Le juste considère la maison du méchant; L''Eternel précipite les méchants dans le malheur.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ስለ ኀጥእ ቤት ያስባል፥ ኀጥኣንም ለጥፋት እንደ ተገለበጡ።

verses.en: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
verses.fr: Celui qui ferme son oreille au cri du pauvre Criera lui-même et n''aura point de réponse.
verses.am: የድሀውን ጩኸት እንዳይሰማ ጆሮውን የሚደፍን ሰው፥ እርሱ ራሱ ይጮኻል አይሰማለትምም።

verses.en: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
verses.fr: Un don fait en secret apaise la colère, Et un présent fait en cachette calme une fureur violente.
verses.am: ስጦታ በስውር ቍጣን ታጠፋለች፥ የብብትም ውስጥ ጉቦ ጽኑ ቍጣን ታበርዳለች።

verses.en: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
verses.fr: C''est une joie pour le juste de pratiquer la justice, Mais la ruine est pour ceux qui font le mal.
verses.am: ፍርድን ማድረግ ለጻድቅ ደስታ ነው፤ ኃጢአትን ለሚያደርጉ ግን ጥፋት ነው።

verses.en: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
verses.fr: L''homme qui s''écarte du chemin de la sagesse Reposera dans l''assemblée des morts.
verses.am: ከማስተዋል መንገድ የሚሳሳት ሰው በሙታን ጉባኤ ያርፋል።

verses.en: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
verses.fr: Celui qui aime la joie reste dans l''indigence; Celui qui aime le vin et l''huile ne s''enrichit pas.
verses.am: ተድላ የሚወድድ ድሀ ይሆናል፥ የወይን ጠጅንና ዘይትንም የሚወድድ ባለጠጋ አይሆንም።

verses.en: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
verses.fr: Le méchant sert de rançon pour le juste, Et le perfide pour les hommes droits.
verses.am: ኀጥእ የጻድቅ ቤዛ ነው፤ በደለኛም የቅን ሰው ቤዛ ነው።

verses.en: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut habiter dans une terre déserte, Qu''avec une femme querelleuse et irritable.
verses.am: ከጠበኛና ከቍጡ ሴት ጋር ከመቀመጥ በምድረ በዳ መቀመጥ ይሻላል።

verses.en: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
verses.fr: De précieux trésors et de l''huile sont dans la demeure du sage; Mais l''homme insensé les engloutit.
verses.am: የከበረ መዝገብና ዘይት በጠቢብ ሰው ቤት ይኖራል። አእምሮ የሌለው ሰው ግን ይውጠዋል።

verses.en: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
verses.fr: Celui qui poursuit la justice et la bonté Trouve la vie, la justice et la gloire.
verses.am: ጽድቅንና ምሕረትን የሚከተል ሕይወትንና ጽድቅን ክብርንም ያገኛል።

verses.en: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
verses.fr: Le sage monte dans la ville des héros, Et il abat la force qui lui donnait de l''assurance.
verses.am: ጠቢብ የኃያላንን ከተማ ይገባባታል፥ የሚታመኑበትንም ኃይል ያፈርሳል።

verses.en: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
verses.fr: Celui qui veille sur sa bouche et sur sa langue Préserve son âme des angoisses.
verses.am: አፉንና ምላሱን የሚጠብቅ ነፍሱን ከመከራ ይጠብቃል።

verses.en: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
verses.fr: L''orgueilleux, le hautain, s''appelle un moqueur; Il agit avec la fureur de l''arrogance.
verses.am: ኵሩና ተጓዳጅ ሰው ፌዘኛ ይባላል፤ እርሱም በትዕቢት ቍጣ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
verses.fr: Les désirs du paresseux le tuent, Parce que ses mains refusent de travailler;
verses.am: ታካችን ምኞቱ ትገድለዋለች፥ እጆቹ ይሠሩ ዘንድ አይፈቅዱምና።

verses.en: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
verses.fr: Tout le jour il éprouve des désirs; Mais le juste donne sans parcimonie.
verses.am: ኀጥእ ቀኑን ሁሉ ምኞትን ይመኛል፤ ጻድቅ ግን ይሰጣል፥ አይሰስትም።

verses.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
verses.fr: Le sacrifice des méchants est quelque chose d''abominable; Combien plus quand ils l''offrent avec des pensées criminelles!
verses.am: የኀጥኣን መሥዋዕት አስጸያፊ ነው፤ ይልቁንም በክፉ አሳብ ሲያቀርቡት አስጸያፊ ነው።

verses.en: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
verses.fr: Le témoin menteur périra, Mais l''homme qui écoute parlera toujours.
verses.am: ሐሰተኛ ምስክር ይጠፋል፤ የሚሰማ ሰው ግን ተጠንቅቆ ይናገራል።

verses.en: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
verses.fr: Le méchant prend un air effronté, Mais l''homme droit affermit sa voie.
verses.am: ኀጥእ ፊቱን ያጠነክራል፤ ቅን ሰው ግን መንገዱን ያጸናል።

verses.en: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the Lord.
verses.fr: Il n''y a ni sagesse, ni intelligence, Ni conseil, en face de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ጥበብ ወይም ማስተዋል ወይም ምክር በእግዚአብሔር ላይ የለም።

verses.en: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the Lord.
verses.fr: Le cheval est équipé pour le jour de la bataille, Mais la délivrance appartient à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ፈረስ ለጦርነት ቀን ይዘጋጃል፤ ድል ግን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
verses.fr: La réputation est préférable à de grandes richesses, Et la grâce vaut mieux que l''argent et que l''or.
verses.am: መልካም ስም ከብዙ ባለጠግነት ይሻላል፥ መልካምም ሞገስ ከብርና ከወርቅ ይበልጣል።

verses.en: The rich and poor meet together: the Lord is the maker of them all.
verses.fr: Le riche et le pauvre se rencontrent; C''est l''Eternel qui les a faits l''un et l''autre.
verses.am: ባለጠና ድሀ ተገናኙ፤ እግዚአብሔር የሁላቸው ፈጣሪ ነው።

verses.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.fr: L''homme prudent voit le mal et se cache, Mais les simples avancent et sont punis.
verses.am: ብልህ ሰው ክፉን አይቶ ይሸሸጋል፤ አላዋቂዎች ግን አልፈው ይጐዳሉ።

verses.en: By humility and the fear of the Lord are riches, and honour, and life.
verses.fr: Le fruit de l''humilité, de la crainte de l''Eternel, C''est la richesse, la gloire et la vie.
verses.am: ትሕትናና እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ባለጠግነት ክብር ሕይወትም ነው።

verses.en: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
verses.fr: Des épines, des pièges sont sur la voie de l''homme pervers; Celui qui garde son âme s''en éloigne.
verses.am: እሾህና ወጥመድ በጠማማ ሰው መንገድ ናቸው፤ ነፍሱን ግን የሚጠብቅ ከእነርሱ ይርቃል።

verses.en: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
verses.fr: Instruis l''enfant selon la voie qu''il doit suivre; Et quand il sera vieux, il ne s''en détournera pas.
verses.am: ልጅን በሚሄድበት መንገድ ምራው፥ በሸመገለም ጊዜ ከእርሱ ፈቀቅ አይልም።

verses.en: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.fr: Le riche domine sur les pauvres, Et celui qui emprunte est l''esclave de celui qui prête.
verses.am: ባለጠጋ ድሆችን ይገዛል፥ ተበዳሪም የአበዳሪ ባሪያ ነው።

verses.en: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
verses.fr: Celui qui sème l''iniquité moissonne l''iniquité, Et la verge de sa fureur disparaît.
verses.am: ኃጢአትን የሚዘራ መከራን ያጭዳል፥ የቍጣውም በትር ይጠፋል።

verses.en: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
